title: CyberSecurityRumble Quals
description:
The CyberSecurityRumble Germany is back, this year with an even bigger final as part of the Deutsche Hackingmeisterschaft!

The CSR this year will have 24h online quals.

The Quals are a Jeopardy style CTF.

**Max Team size is 6 Hackers!**
Everybody is allowed to participate online.

Again we'll have tasks in all categories: pwn, rev, crypto, web, ... from beginner friendly to 31337!

The onsite final will be in Bonn, Germany. The TOP 8 student teams from Germany will be invited to compete with the 24 best participants of the CSCG in the finals.
prizes:
German student teams:

* TOP 8 teams will qualify for the Deutsche Hackingmeisterschaft onsite in Bonn.
* The winner team at the finals will get a fully paid trip to DEFCON Las Vegas.
